name: HM-CW
roles: sequence=(customer, ISO week), ordered by week then customer id; event=one purchase day of that customer in the week; item=article_id; utility=round(price*1e6) per row (one row = one unit), summed per item and day; the price column is scaled by an undisclosed constant
regularity_bound_rule: 2 weeks of sequences, ceil(2 * N / weeks)
